title: stage describe answer
description: frames/2 only. A stage with geometry declared answers `apply STAGE --describe --width W --height H --depth D --fps N/D [--frames N] [--param K=V]... [--layer ID=PATH]...` with this document on standard output, reads no standard input and exits 0; a refusal is an error document (error.schema.json) with the stage exit codes 2, 3 or 4. Only width, height and frames may change: depth and fps equal the request, and a stage that would change the rate refuses with unsupported. A wrapper chains the answers stage by stage and passes the last one to encode and verify. Identical in every repository that follows the convention.

fps.description: Equal to the requested --fps, as an exact N/D.

frames.description: Output frame count, or null when the input count was not given and the stage cannot tell.
